policy: canonicalize registry serverId only against an explicit bounded canonicalServerIds set
case variants may resolve only when they normalize to one explicit canonical server identity
preserve every raw registry serverId as evidence
unknown or unsupported server aliases remain UNVERIFIED
an explicit server hint may disambiguate only a canonical server already bound to the resolved project
environment is part of candidate identity and remains preserved
serverPath and realPath are evidence only and never become server identity
project-resolution registry digests and server-registry evidence digests are distinct evidence domains and are not required to be equal unless an explicit contract binding declares that relation
raw server evidence ordering is deterministic and locale-independent
resolver is READ_ONLY and never mutates GitRegistry, infers authorization or invokes SSH mutation

finalGreen.head: 087b0a23230c83b6cb1c9069947f48a5d8cc0357
checks: read-only safety tests including all GWC-6 cases

behavior: GW-07 resolves bounded server candidates from current ProjectResolution plus explicit GitRegistry server evidence.
Canonical identity is selected only from canonicalServerIds; raw aliases remain evidence.
Multiple canonical server identities return AMBIGUOUS unless a verified bound hint narrows the result.
Missing/stale registry evidence, unknown aliases and project/mapping mismatch remain fail-closed.
GW-07 wrapper binds contract version metadata without adding permission, mutation or SSH semantics.
Repeated identical input and evidence produce an identical semantic result.
implementation.authorityBoundary: GitRegistry remains the server-binding authority; ProjectResolution remains the predecessor project authority; GWC-6 is a pure read-only resolver and creates no second registry, authorization authority or SSH mutation path.

checkpoint.claimReleaseRule: Retain the existing GWC-6 branch-local claim until the checkpoint projection passes exact-head CI; release only after that validation.

nextAction: Create and validate the GWC-6 canonical checkpoint on the exact branch head. After checkpoint CI succeeds, release the GWC-6 claim and dispatch GWC-PRE-E-GWC-7 without replaying GWC-6.
